scope: Curated supporting research for photographed Oral Pathology and Oral Microbiology topics; not all research or a complete textbook.

documents.title: Primary Tuberculosis of Buccal and Labial Mucosa: Literature Review and a Rare Case Report of a Public Health Menace
documents.study_context: Single patient with primary buccal and labial mucosal tuberculosis plus literature review.
limitations: Single case cannot estimate prevalence or establish diagnostic accuracy or treatment effectiveness.

documents.title: Role of immunohistochemistry in diagnosing round-cell tumours affecting the oral and maxillofacial regions
documents.study_context: Formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded round-cell tumour specimens from oral and maxillofacial regions.
limitations: Selected tumour spectrum; marker panels require clinicopathological interpretation.

documents.title: Salivary Gland Bioengineering
documents.study_context: Salivary gland development and bioengineering literature spanning cell cultures and preclinical models.
limitations: Engineered tissue and preclinical regeneration are not established clinical treatments.

documents.title: Oral streptococci: modulators of health and disease
documents.study_context: Commensal and pathogenic oral streptococci literature across host observations and laboratory models.
limitations: Species and strains differ; laboratory mechanisms do not establish human therapeutic benefit.

documents.title: Neuroscience of taste: unlocking the human taste code
documents.study_context: Behavioral and single-fiber taste recordings across nonhuman primates with comparison to human taste.
limitations: Species differences limit direct transfer to human taste physiology.

documents.title: Drug-resistant oral candidiasis in patients with HIV infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis
documents.study_context: Studies of antifungal resistance among Candida isolates from HIV-positive people with oral candidiasis.
limitations: Population and assay heterogeneity; resistance prevalence does not select an individual prescription.

documents.title: Determination of sample size for various study designs in medical research: A practical primer
documents.study_context: Sample-size planning across observational and experimental study designs; no single patient cohort.
limitations: Sample-size formulas depend on effect assumptions and design; power is not proof of validity.

documents.title: Presence and Causes of Sterilization Equipment Failures with Biological Indicators in Dental Offices in Mexico: A Longitudinal Cohort
documents.study_context: Biological-indicator monitoring of sterilizers in 175 dental offices in San Luis Potosi, Mexico.
limitations: Local equipment and practices limit generalizability; no substitute for validated infection-control protocols.

documents.title: Oral microbiome in human health and diseases
documents.study_context: Oral microbiome literature across human associations and mechanistic models.
limitations: Microbiome associations are not causal proof; mechanisms and populations differ.

documents.title: EDA Variants Are Responsible for Approximately 90% of Deciduous Tooth Agenesis
documents.study_context: Whole-exome and Sanger sequencing in 84 patients with severe deciduous tooth agenesis.
limitations: Selected severe cohort; reported gene proportions do not generalize to all tooth agenesis.

documents.title: Fundamentals of Nonparametric Statistical Tests for Dental Clinical Research
documents.study_context: Nonparametric statistical procedures illustrated for dental clinical research; no single study population.
limitations: Distribution-free tests still have design and independence assumptions; significance is not clinical importance.

excluded_paragraph_patterns.reason: Broad claim about nonparametric-test assumptions is misleading; entire section held pending statistical review.

documents.title: Bioengineering the Junctional Epithelium in 3D Oral Mucosa Models
documents.study_context: Three-dimensional oral mucosa and junctional epithelium model literature.
limitations: Experimental reconstructed tissues do not reproduce every human tissue function.

documents.title: The Emergence of Saliva as a Diagnostic and Prognostic Tool for Viral Infections
documents.study_context: Saliva-based viral diagnostic literature across assays and clinical studies.
limitations: Assay accuracy depends on specimen handling, population and comparator; no standalone diagnosis.

documents.title: Inflammation and immune response in the development of periodontal disease: a narrative review
documents.study_context: Periodontal inflammation and immune response literature including human and mechanistic research.
limitations: Heterogeneous evidence and models; no individualized periodontal treatment guidance.

documents.title: Oral microbiota in aging and diseases
documents.study_context: Oral microbiota and aging literature integrating human observational and mechanistic evidence.
limitations: Age-related associations are confounded and do not establish causation.

documents.title: Global health trends of human papillomavirus‐associated oral cancer: A review
documents.study_context: Human papillomavirus-associated oral cancer literature; oral and oropharyngeal sites must be distinguished.
limitations: Site definitions and geographic evidence vary; HPV association alone does not diagnose cancer.

documents.title: Clinico‐Pathological Significance of Tumor Infiltrating Immune Cells in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma—Hope or Hype?
documents.study_context: Immune infiltrates in oral squamous cell carcinoma histology from 111 patients.
limitations: Correlations do not establish causation or validate an individual prognostic test.

documents.title: Chromosome Analysis Using Spectral Karyotyping (SKY)
documents.study_context: Spectral karyotyping principles with human chromosome-analysis case examples.
limitations: Karyotyping resolution and examples limit inference; no comprehensive genetic diagnosis.

documents.title: Oral candidiasis: A retrospective study of 276 Brazilian patients
documents.study_context: 276 Brazilian patients with oral candidiasis.
limitations: Retrospective selected cohort; findings do not generalize to all populations or determine individual treatment.

documents.title: Descriptive Statistics and Normality Tests for Statistical Data
documents.study_context: Descriptive summaries and normality-test methods; no single clinical population.
limitations: Simplified heuristics; statistical assumptions depend on design and model, not a universal cutoff.

excluded_paragraph_patterns.pattern: Central limit theorem states that when sample size has 100
excluded_paragraph_patterns.reason: Universal sample-size normality heuristic is misleading; statistical assumptions depend on design, sampling and model.

excluded_paragraph_patterns.pattern: extreme values in the data set have no significant impact on the mean
excluded_paragraph_patterns.reason: Claim about extreme values and sample mean is misleading; section held pending statistical review.

documents.title: 3D cellular visualization of intact mouse tooth using optical clearing without decalcification
documents.study_context: Optical clearing and three-dimensional visualization of intact mouse teeth.
limitations: Mouse tissue imaging results do not validate every human histology application.

documents.title: Tooth Formation: Are the Hardest Tissues of Human Body Hard to Regenerate?
documents.study_context: Dental tissue and whole-tooth regeneration literature spanning cellular and animal models; not a human treatment trial.
limitations: Experimental regeneration does not establish routine human clinical effectiveness.

excluded_paragraph_patterns.pattern: epithelium is derived from the embryonic endoderm
excluded_paragraph_patterns.reason: Publisher statement conflicts with established oral ectoderm origin of dental epithelium. Entire section held without correcting original source; requires faculty review.

documents.title: A Systematic Review of Oral Biopsies, Sample Types, and Detection Techniques Applied in Relation to Oral Cancer Detection
documents.study_context: Oral biopsy specimens, sample types and detection techniques in oral cancer literature.
limitations: Heterogeneous sampling and diagnostic methods; no single screening method replaces clinical assessment.

documents.title: Unveiling the arcanum of formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded archival tissue blocks: A valuable resource for genomic DNA extraction
documents.study_context: Genomic DNA extraction from human formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tumour blocks stored up to 11 years.
limitations: Archival laboratory results are protocol-specific and do not establish diagnostic accuracy.

documents.title: Type IVb Hypersensitivity Reaction in the Novel Murine Model of Palladium–Induced Intraoral Allergic Contact Mucositis
documents.study_context: Palladium-induced intraoral allergic contact mucositis in sensitized mice.
limitations: Mouse hypersensitivity model does not establish human diagnosis or treatment.

documents.title: An improved method for preparing stained ground teeth sections
documents.study_context: Undemineralized human premolars and impacted teeth extracted for orthodontic purposes; rosin, H&E and unstained ground sections compared.
limitations: Laboratory preparation and morphology results do not establish clinical diagnostic accuracy.

documents.title: Decoding (digital) histopathology: The building blocks for computational researchers
documents.study_context: Foundational pathology laboratory workflow for computational researchers; no single clinical cohort.
limitations: Educational laboratory overview; computational guidance does not validate an autonomous diagnosis or clinical treatment.
